purpose: Reproducibility checkpoint for the source-question extraction workbench; not a website runtime dependency.
instructions: Restore files under a science-next working directory.
The ordered source list maps zero-based index i to e{i}.docx. Fetch original files from their recorded repository paths and verify Git blob SHA1 before extraction.
The original e10 is unused and was not successfully fetched; do not treat it as imported.
Render source DOCX files to rendered/e{i}.pdf with LibreOffice before builders that crop native figures.
Restore the baseline through batch11 from the recorded commit under sibling science-bulk/output, and the original batch03 bank as science-bulk/old03.js.
Decode priorQuestionsGzipBase64 with base64 then gzip into prior-questions.json. The real quiz-battle-core.mjs and marking normalizer can be fetched from the repository for QA.
Python dependencies: lxml, Pillow, PyMuPDF, reportlab and fontTools; external tools: Inkscape and LibreOffice.
Batch14 readability helper uses the working English-word list; the already-published checked batch14 bank can be retained instead of recreating that auxiliary transformation.
Run the needed builders in ascending batch order, then integrate.py, then check-loaders.mjs. Update the QA expected count when adding a checked batch.
Keep the completed earlier1000-question request as a historical checkpoint. The all-assessments scope is still incomplete, including unresolved password-protected inputs.
Publishing is a separate atomic Git tree/commit/ref update with an expected-head lease; the workbench does not silently publish.
